result_text:
I fixed both problems in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/analysis/files/DuplicationAnalyzer.java`. I ran the `Duplication*` tests in `codeanalyzer`; the output I saw was only log lines, no failures. I didn't add a test for the new behaviour or run the whole module.

- **Component metrics (`addComponentDuplicationMetrics`):**
  - `DUPLICATION_NUMBER_OF_CLEANED_LINES_<decomposition>_<component>` now reports the component's cleaned lines instead of its duplicated lines.
  - `DUPLICATION_PERCENTAGE_<decomposition>_<component>` is now 100 × duplicated lines / cleaned lines. It is 0 when the component has no duplicates or no cleaned lines, so there is no NaN.
- **Most frequent duplicates (`addMostFrequentDuplicates`):** the old code sorted a throwaway copy, so the list came out in discovery order. It now sorts a copy by number of occurrences, highest first, and takes the top-list-size entries. The "more than two occurrences" filter is unchanged.

I noticed one thing I left alone. `DuplicationAggregator.getDuplicationPerLogicalComponent` looks components up by name only, not by decomposition. If two decompositions use the same component name, their counts could be mixed together.
